models_evaluated: deep learning-based AI system for thyroid nodule ultrasound

links.outcome: Malignant nodules misclassified as benign by AI (false-negative results)
links.effect: 123 malignant nodules (8.6% of malignant cases) were mistakenly identified as benign, mostly low or intermediate suspicion; authors advise active surveillance for all such nodules.
links.quote: However, 123 malignant nodules (8.6% of malignant cases) were mistakenly identified as benign, with the majority of these being of low or intermediate suspicion.

links.outcome: AI benign-nodule identification compared with junior and senior radiologists on same cohort
links.effect: AI identified 81.4% (96/118) of benign nodules vs 40% (junior) and 55% (senior) radiologists; AUC 0.88 vs 0.43 (P=.002) and 0.63 (P=.003).
links.quote: It outperformed junior and senior radiologists, who identified only 40% and 55%, respectively.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of an AI model to identify benign thyroid nodules and compare it with radiologists, but does not evaluate an operational deployment practice or guardrail.
